rng_stream_convention: default_rng(seed + i), one independent stream per background 'event' i

pool_generation_settings.note: 125,000-event pool per the paper's own Sec III D; this project uses 20,000 events by explicit user decision, not a paper requirement or a feasibility finding -- see RUN_LOG.md 2026-09-16 ~14:40. Sampling from this pool is WITH REPLACEMENT (documented assumption, not specified by the paper or ref[34]), so results have REDUCED STATISTICAL INDEPENDENCE relative to the paper's own 125,000-event pool and must never be described as an exact paper-sized reproduction.

primary_vertex_convention: global origin (0,0,0), NOT SPECIFIED by paper/ref[34] for a no-hard-vertex event -- documented assumption
one_analysed_event_definition: one full bunch crossing: Poisson(mu) pile-up interactions' combined hits, NO hard-scatter object
caveat: Reproduces the paper's two directly-counted HEADLINE sanity numbers (Sec IV: ~1e-3 at >=4/8 layers, ~6e-5 at 8/8 layers) ONLY. Does NOT reproduce the paper's actual final signal-region background yield, which uses a separate reweighting scheme (Sec IV: derive the Fig 5 distribution from 1-hit-per-layer events, weighted by the efficiency of the stricter 2-hit requirement) -- not implemented here.
